title: architect dev
summary: acme now runs for real on this Mac. One command starts the generated server on workerd, with its world and a fresh local database. The world signs people in for testing. Ada founds an organisation and grants Olga 500 from the generated command line, and gets an allowance id back. Over the cap, she's refused with exit 44. Bob isn't the owner, so he's refused with exit 3 before the handler ever runs. Stopping it leaves nothing running. Meanwhile, a separate author wrote stage one's journey and a planted fixture for each eval, ready for prove.
proves: architect dev & then acme allowance grant prints an allowance id. curl to the route returns 200.
